reviewed_interfaces.MODEL_STATE: Q01/V01 nominal grid/conditional region; four-only fit, fresh raw-disjoint heldout, common navigation version. No strict task risk guarantee.
reviewed_interfaces.WRITER: Live UTF-8 case/batch/active quotas; reserved outcome plus bounded actual return on quota failure; no source copies or full covariance traces.
reviewed_interfaces.RETURN: Conditional reference return reserves, actual images/posterior recheck, bounded departure recovery; no terminal RTT pose update.
reviewed_interfaces.ENTRY: Require first-frame on-site pixel envelope as well as return forecast before leaving a reference for an inset point. At most two arrival images then immediately recenter on failure before another finite attempt; do not spend an unchecked second wait. Fixed input distinguishes a passing return from rejected first frame.
reviewed_interfaces.PLANNER: P01 96 shared center/inward/outward candidates; outward half-ray clearance capped by existing inset length. Stage/cost same candidates/quotas. Ranking template retains shared bias via exact rank-one inverse; actual complete C and all admission/4+1 gates remain authoritative.
reviewed_interfaces.FORECAST: UAV/map principal covariance submatrix only in pure admission forecasts, no Schur conditioning; coupled-clone covariance equality checked. Actual joint navigation, measurements and fitting unchanged.
reviewed_interfaces.OFFLINE: Truth coordinates, bias and return endpoints export only after MotionWorld.finish; independent Python audit reconstructs errors, conditional witnesses and completion.
reviewed_interfaces.SEARCH_PRIORITY: Until all registered IDs are discovered, proposals may use only current/next coverage reference; stage/cost share restriction. All-discovered releases priority without requiring all finite fits; unseeded IDs remain explicit and use finite coverage fallback. No new numeric allowance or physical changes.

joint_nominal18.scope: optimistic noiseless fixed input only; no task feasibility or population coverage claim

evidence.independent_information_check: Direct covariance inverse on 96 recorded fixed candidates passed; +0.001 corrupted gain rejected.

open_items: Verify actual discovery/localization/return with the search-period reference restriction. Previous nominal18 case found 8/10 and closed 4/10, with actual return; do not claim full closure.
Freeze unchanged source/config and unseen seeds for paired comparison after integration; all negative results retained.
10 m upper-envelope pressure comparison must use same final algorithms/geometry, not pooled old-version outcomes.

pending_preference.height: user permits candidates; not a fixed scene constraint
pending_preference.noise: user confirmed matched nominal 5 m main; upper 10 m pressure comparison; physical noise and 20 m/3 m unchanged
